column1: Super+Alt+Shift+S                 📤 Take window out of scratchpad
Super+Apostrophe                  📌 Scratchpad terminal (reused window, not a new one each time)
Super+Tab                         🏷️ Jump to a window by its letter label
Super+Alt+Backslash               🧩 Cycle layout: scroller, tile, grid, monocle, deck, center
Super+Ctrl+grave                  🗂️ Special tag overlay: show or hide
Super+Ctrl+Shift+grave            🗂️ Send window to or from the special tag
Super+Alt+G                       📍 Pin window to every tag
Super+Shift+Y                     ⬆️ Keep window always on top
Super+F2                          🎈 Float or tile every window on this tag
Super+BracketLeft                 Consume or expel window left;
Super+BracketRight                Consume or expel window right;
Super+Ctrl+F                      Expand column to available width;
Super+Ctrl+Page_Down              Move column to workspace down;
Super+Ctrl+Page_Up                Move column to workspace up;
Super+Ctrl+U                      Move column to workspace down;
Super+Ctrl+I                      Move column to workspace up;
Super+Ctrl+WheelScrollDown        Move column to workspace down;
Super+Ctrl+WheelScrollUp          Move column to workspace up;
Super+Shift+Ctrl+Left             Move column to monitor left;
Super+Shift+Ctrl+Down             Move column to monitor down;
Super+Shift+Ctrl+Up               Move column to monitor up;
Super+Shift+Ctrl+Right            Move column to monitor right;
Super+Shift+Ctrl+H                Move column to monitor left;
Super+Shift+Ctrl+J                Move column to monitor down;
Super+Shift+Ctrl+K                Move column to monitor up;
Super+Shift+Ctrl+L                Move column to monitor right;

column2: grim -g "$(mmsg get focusing-client | jq -r '"\(.x),\(.y) \(.width)x\(.height)"')" - | tee ~/Pictures/Screenshots/Screenshot\ from\ $(date +'%Y-%m-%d\ %H-%M-%S').png | wl-copy

column1: Super+Ctrl+Alt+F                  🔄 Restart foot server (closes footclient windows)
